name: healthcare-public-data
description: Research public healthcare evidence, clinical trials, medications, devices, providers, hospitals, and Medicare data.

interface.longDescription:
Research healthcare questions using trusted public information from official U.S. government sources. Explore biomedical research, scientific literature, and clinical trials; review medication labels, drug identifiers, recalls, shortages, approvals, and medical-device records; look up healthcare providers and facilities; and explore Medicare coverage policies plus curated Part B physician, Part D prescribing, and inpatient hospital payment data.

Healthcare Public Data preserves source attribution and data dates, distinguishes reported facts from interpretation, and supports research without accessing personal medical records. ChatGPT can make mistakes and isn't intended for diagnosis or treatment. Consult a doctor for medical advice. CMS Open Payments, Medicaid, hospice, and dialysis data are not exposed by CMS Open Data; use the appropriate official source for those questions.
defaultPrompt: What does PubMed research say about lowering LDL cholesterol to protect heart health?
What forms of metoprolol are listed in DailyMed?
